name: Docking: Axelrod's culture on the move
description: Axtell et al. 1996's mobility experiment in the Sugarscape: 100 agents with vision 5–10 on one Gaussian sugar mountain (σ = 25, height 4; see dock-mountain) move, eat and then run Axelrod's culture rule with one neighbor; metric: distinct cultures after 20 000 ticks, against the traits per feature (5 features). They report 1.1 ± 0.3 cultures at 15 traits and 2.2 ± 1.2 at 30, every run reaching their global stop. Measured (release, seeds 1–5, recorded 2026-09-30): 1.0, 1.2, 1.0 and 1.8 at 5, 10, 15 and 30 traits, every run stopping: mobility collapses diversity (the fixed 10 × 10 lattice: about 20), and 30 traits leave the most, as they found.
